CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION marathon.saldo_aplicado(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(sum(case when tipo='APLICACION'then monto when tipo='REVERSO_APLICACION'then -monto else 0 end),0)
 from marathon.saldo_eventos where aplicacion_id=p_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION marathon.saldo_deudas(p_dni text)
 RETURNS TABLE(tipo text, id text, fecha date, hora time without time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, cargo numeric, pagado numeric, deuda numeric, sede text, profesional text, terapia text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with all_debts as(
 select 'sesion'::text tipo,t.id,t.fecha,t.hora,t.created_at,
 greatest(0,t.importe-coalesce((select sum(a.monto)from marathon.saldo_ajustes_sesion a where a.turno_id=t.id),0))cargo,
 marathon.saldo_pagado('sesion',t.id)pagado,t.sede,t.profesional_id profesional,t.terapia_id terapia
 from marathon.turnos t where t.dni=p_dni and t.estado='PRESENTE'
 union all
 select 'cuota',q.id::text,q.fecha,'00:00'::time,q.created_at,greatest(0,q.importe-coalesce((select sum(a.importe)from marathon.agenda_ajustes a where a.cuota_id=q.id),0)),marathon.saldo_pagado('cuota',q.id::text),q.sede,
 (select hs.profesional_id from marathon.agenda_horarios hs where hs.plan_id=q.plan_id and(hs.hasta is null or hs.hasta>hs.desde)order by case when hs.desde<=q.fecha and(hs.hasta is null or q.fecha<hs.hasta)then 0 when hs.desde>q.fecha then 1 else 2 end,hs.desde,hs.dia,hs.hora,hs.id limit 1),p.terapia_id
 from marathon.agenda_cuotas q join marathon.agenda_planes p on p.id=q.plan_id where p.dni=p_dni
 union all
 select 'bono',b.id,b.fecha,b.hora,b.created_at,b.importe,marathon.saldo_pagado('bono',b.id),b.sede,b.profesional_id,b.terapia_id
 from marathon.bonos_serie b where b.dni=p_dni and b.estado='ACTIVO')
 select d.tipo,d.id,d.fecha,d.hora,d.created_at,d.cargo,d.pagado,greatest(0,d.cargo-d.pagado),d.sede,d.profesional,d.terapia from all_debts d
 order by d.fecha,d.hora,d.created_at,d.tipo,d.id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.marathon_daily_options()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if not marathon.active_user()then raise sqlstate '42501'using message='Acceso no autorizado.';end if;
 return public.marathon_catalog_options()||jsonb_build_object(
 'professionals',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',pr.id,'label',concat_ws(' ',pr.nombre,pr.apellido),'estado',pr.estado,'therapy_ids',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(pt.terapia_id order by pt.terapia_id)from marathon.profesional_terapias pt where pt.profesional_id=pr.id),'[]'::jsonb))order by pr.apellido,pr.nombre,pr.id)from marathon.profesionales pr),'[]'::jsonb),
 'actors',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'label',label)order by label,id)from(select user_id::text id,display_name label from marathon.app_users union select 'legacy:'||secretaria_legacy,secretaria_legacy from marathon.movimientos where created_by is null and secretaria_legacy is not null union select 'legacy:'||secretaria_legacy,secretaria_legacy from marathon.ortopedia_operaciones where created_by is null and secretaria_legacy is not null union select 'unknown','Sin registro')q),'[]'::jsonb),
 'secretaries',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',nombre,'label',nombre,'estado',estado)order by nombre)from marathon.secretarias),'[]'::jsonb),
 'categories',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id','C:'||name,'label',name)order by name)from(select distinct coalesce(categoria,case when origen='ORTOPEDIA'then'Ortopedia'else'Otros'end)name from marathon.movimientos where origen<>'BONO' union select 'Otros' union select 'Ortopedia')q),'[]'::jsonb));
end $function$
